_comment: Water Phase 0 authored composition contract. DATA ONLY: no playable terrain, gates, nodes, flows or performance proof. Source BUILD_WATER_ARCHIPELAGO_TO_COMPLETION section3 and owner directive/boards. Metres, realm-local XYZ. Starting numbers tunable; derived lengths are calculated from listed polylines.

terrain._comment: Separate aligned bake bounds pad authored world bounds without moving islands. Sparse island+shore regions avoid a giant empty seabed bake.
terrain.region_selection: Only regions intersecting island radius plus shore_apron_m; water gaps do not require terrain collision.
terrain.collision_comment: FULL_GAME on sparse island regions; measure memory/startup and two separated remote bodies. One averaged camera is insufficient.

height_formula._comment: Deterministic analytic base surface, highest finite island contribution. Trail grading later requires explicit modifier; not implied here.
height_formula.angular_profile: For each landing sector angular distance d: w=1-smoothstep(half_width_deg,half_width_deg+feather_deg,d). Choose maximum weight and lerp default beach width and inner height toward its profile.
height_formula.ocean: When r>R: h=-min(seabed_depth,(r-R)*outer_shore_slope). Beyond sparse regions, depth queries return deep sea; no synthetic walkable floor.
height_formula.shore: r=R gives h=0 exactly. Straight crossing gap=center_distance-R_from-R_to.
height_formula.noise: Disabled until a shoreline-preserving mask exists. Future detail must be zero at shore and safe anchors.

scatter._comment: Water scatter config is future implementation. Meadows fingerprint is insufficient. Exclude landing/approach clear radii.

veilfall_identity.hike_contract: Author graded switchbacks from safe arrival to the waterfall gate at139.396m, matching waterfall_gate_height_m. Existing radial slope is too steep to assume walkable. Do not solve using teleport or surface snapping.

route_safety_analysis._comment: Analytic lower-bound speed with full adverse current magnitude; no steering loss, waves, encounter delay, regeneration or food included. Validate with real bodies. Surface polyline conservatively includes wading ends.
route_safety_analysis._comment_final: All five compatible mounts at Swimming0 and10. Survival is not comfortable reserve: Cannonback and Riverdrake remain near exhaustion at level0 and need earned skill/preparation or route tuning. No steering-loss or runtime safety claim.

planning_census._comment: Counts of authored DATA, not spawned/played actuals. Water routes count sheltered edge once; direct alternatives are not additional chapter kilometres. Land lengths count listed spines and distinct loops once, not walkback multiplicity.
planning_census.unique_land_plan_length_status: Raw authored 3D planning polylines total 11.686km, including steep ungraded terrain; this is not playable distance and must not be credited against the 8km actual walked target.
planning_census._comment_lesson: Separate60m inshore lesson is not counted as an inter-island edge or added to chapter water kilometres.
